title: 11.1 Answer to Life, the Universe and Everything
prompt: 11.1 Write a program that computes the Answer to the Ultimate Question of Life, the Universe, and Everything. Sample output is below.
learning_objective: Compute and print the Answer to Life, the Universe, and Everything (from The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy).
hint: In The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy, the Answer is 6 * 7 — compute and print that product.
solution_explanation: The joke answer from The Hitchhiker's Guide is 42, which is just 6 * 7 printed.

student.py.starter: # Print the answer — but it must be computed, not hard-coded

OutputTests.test_desired_output.title: Matches desired output
OutputTests.test_desired_output.feedback: Compare your program output carefully to the Desired Output.

SourceTests.test_source_print.title: Source check: require 'print'
SourceTests.test_source_print.feedback: By now you should know that a print function would be helpful here.

SourceTests.test_source_star.title: Source check: require '*'
SourceTests.test_source_star.feedback: I think that multiplication is involved...

SourceTests.test_source_not_42.title: Source check: forbid '42'
SourceTests.test_source_not_42.feedback: Do not hard-code 42 — compute the answer.
